name: Magneton
description: Three MAGNEMITE are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the foe with its whole body.

moves.name: Supersonic
moves.description: The user generates odd sound waves from its body. It may confuse the target.

moves.name: Thunder Shock
moves.description: A jolt of electricity is hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the foe paralyzed.

moves.name: Tri Attack
moves.description: The user strikes with a simultaneous three- beam attack. May also paralyze, burn, or freeze the target.

moves.name: Metal Sound
moves.description: A horrible sound like scraping metal is emitted to sharply reduce the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Sonic Boom
moves.description: The foe is hit with a destructive shock wave that always inflicts 20 HP damage.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: A weak electric charge is launched at the foe. It causes paralysis if it hits.

moves.name: Spark
moves.description: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the foe. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

moves.name: Lock-On
moves.description: The user takes sure aim at the foe. It ensures the next attack does not fail to hit the target.

moves.name: Magnet Bomb
moves.description: The user launches a steel bomb that sticks to the target. This attack will not miss.

moves.name: Screech
moves.description: An earsplitting screech is emitted to sharply reduce the foe’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Discharge
moves.description: A flare of electricity is loosed to strike all Pokémon in battle. It may also cause paralysis.

moves.name: Mirror Shot
moves.description: The user looses a flash of energy from its polished body. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.

moves.name: Magnet Rise
moves.description: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.

moves.name: Gyro Ball
moves.description: The user tackles the foe with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

moves.name: Zap Cannon
moves.description: The user fires an electric blast like a cannon to inflict damage and cause paralysis.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: A strong electric blast is loosed at the foe. It may also leave the foe paralyzed.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: A weak electric charge is launched at the foe. It causes paralysis if it hits.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Flash
moves.description: The user flashes a light that cuts the foe’s accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.

moves.name: Explosion
moves.description: The user explodes to inflict damage on all Pokémon in battle. The user faints upon using this move.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.description: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Return
moves.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Frustration
moves.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Hidden Power
moves.description: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water- type moves.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

moves.name: Recycle
moves.description: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

moves.name: Secret Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

moves.name: Shock Wave
moves.description: The user strikes the foe with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.

moves.name: Gyro Ball
moves.description: The user tackles the foe with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

moves.name: Natural Gift
moves.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

moves.name: Flash Cannon
moves.description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Charge Beam
moves.description: The user fires a concentrated bundle of electricity. It may also raise the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the foe. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the foe flinch.

moves.name: Rollout
moves.description: The user continually rolls into the foe over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

moves.name: Magic Coat
moves.description: A barrier reflects back to the foe moves like Leech Seed and moves that damage status.

moves.name: Signal Beam
moves.description: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. It may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

moves.name: Gravity
moves.description: Gravity is intensified for five turns, making moves involving flying unusable and negating Levitation.

moves.name: Magnet Rise
moves.description: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.
